source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Stress-test the current fantasy visual semantics by rendering the agent-selected alchemist plus summoner pair in a complex photorealistic scene, using the attached portrait only as visible appearance guidance for an original adult fictional woman.
subject: One original adult fictional woman alchemist-summoner, with visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair guided by the attached portrait, plus one separately embodied glass-and-vapor entity.
setting: A copper-and-glass heatwork laboratory containing a connected crucible, retort, condenser, and receiver.
event: The operator transforms a mineral slurry through connected apparatus while a separately embodied entity arrives from the bounded receiver mouth and responds to her directing gesture.
visual_priorities: Operator, connected apparatus, input and output material states, a bounded transition, and physical residue must be jointly readable.
The arriving entity must be distinct from the operator and apparatus, visibly emerge from a bounded source, respond to her gesture, and produce a grounded local consequence.
The attached portrait controls visible facial appearance, dark wavy hair, and restrained makeup balance only; the subject remains an original adult fictional woman.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy process-documentation photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. In a copper-and-glass heatwork laboratory she regulates flame beneath a connected crucible, retort, condenser, and receiver. Show dark mineral slurry entering the heated crucible and translucent crystalline fluid collecting in the receiver, joined by a visible amber-to-clear transformation gradient through the glass neck; condensate, mineral slag, and a stained work surface record the process. From the same bounded receiver mouth, one separately embodied glass-and-vapor entity emerges into the room, oriented toward her raised directing hand rather than fused to the apparatus. Its arrival casts a contact shadow and pushes loose droplets outward. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide three-quarter composition that keeps her hand-to-control contact, the full apparatus chain, both material states, entity-source relation, and residue readable together.
